scope: All evaluated native vectors from the single authorized batch; no optimizer launched by this verifier.
hca_control: Original root HCA: grouped wider geometry steps, absolute bar indices, and tt repair; not the adjacent audit variant.
limitations: Vector membership cannot prove uniformity or the precise sequence of unrecorded random draws.
BA self/nonself frequencies are descriptive; the intended half-self distribution is a source/native-mechanism contract, not proved by membership.
BA changed-geometry counts describe actual clamped proposals. They cannot identify raw zero draws versus clamped outward draws or prove the six-ticket distribution.
HCA possible-group sets are compatible explanations, not reconstructed actual random groups.
Incumbents and restores are reconstructed; candidate traces do not directly log internal incumbents.
Exact candidate and best Double bytes are logged directly; no native recost or changed price tolerance is used.
Targets use existing ten-decimal CSV presentation; exact first-best is checked separately.
Capped target effort assigns the full5000 evaluated budget to a miss; it is observed effort, not an estimate of the unobserved eventual time-to-target.
Validity is provided by unchanged native checks; engineering formulas are not independently recomputed here.
target_definition: Best observed valid final price across BOTH methods in this single H5/fc320 batch, under existing ten-decimal native CSV presentation. Attainment means first valid candidate at that same printed price. This symmetric post-batch benchmark is not a proven global optimum. Native Double bytes independently determine acceptance and first-best checks.

complete_sample_comparison.interpretation: Descriptive comparison for the requested case only; all misses remain in capped effort. No adaptive rerun, universal superiority, or statistical significance is implied. User conditionally authorized installation if this unchanged candidate also performs well; report attainment, capped effort, and SD separately without composite weights.
